_adopted.why: seeded from a tree known to be committed. An adoption is not evidence that these bytes were pushed -- it is the baseline the ratchet starts from.

_comment: Written by tools/deliver.py. Per path: the sha256 of the bytes a slice last DELIVERED, and which slice delivered them. audit_delivery names anything on disk whose bytes are not in here and that no manifest claims -- a file that is on disk and in no commit (ADR-147).

ignored.tools/delivery_ledger.json: The ledger cannot record its own bytes: writing the record changes the file, so its stored sha is stale the instant it is written. It is shipped by every slice's manifest like anything else -- what it cannot be is evidence about itself.
